value_leaf_table.derivation: PLAY SCALARS use only in-play depths (<= h_conv_depth_cap): h_conv = min heuristic_lp over those; value_trust_depth = min{d<=cap: value_leaf_lp[d]-h_conv <= tol}; value_no_fallback likewise. (Deep cells d>cap extend the table+crossover for the anchor but do NOT move the escalation gate; a trust_depth > search_depth is equivalent to UNSET in play.) crossover spans ALL depths.

value_fallback_crossover.rule: after escalating a value-leaf line committed at depth c, TAKE the heuristic line iff hcommitted >= take_heuristic_at_hdepth[c] (else keep the leaf). Clamp c/hcommitted to the measured [min,max] depth. Per-committed-depth (NOT a uniform offset).

value_play.note: Dragonstorm value-leaf 2026-07-22 (generate-from-scratch). Combo deck: rollout-label GBDT (200 trees, pair-acc 73.8%). Depth matrix (400g/held-out s4004,s5005): H converges ~d3=4.778, value-leaf converges V5=4.786 (+0.009 vs H3) -> trust UNSET, no_fallback=False. Mirrors the hinata/antilife combo template (depth-aware value-ranked beam W3 leafdepth2 + budget-restore fresh0.5, regime heavy) which bounds the combo tail. Measured ~1.8x faster + quality-neutral at regression budget. PROVISIONAL table; revise after more seeds / mulligan. | 2026-09-03: escalation_fresh_frac key removed -- the escalation's fresh-full budget is engine behavior now (was 0.5 here; 0.5 measured worse than both legacy and fresh-full; see docs/design/escalation-budget-investigation.md).
